notable_absence.finding: Apache Camel, Apache Flink, and Apache Zeppelin are each named with their own external link in the same sentence/paragraph as Apache NiFi, but only NiFi was captured as a representative seeAlso relation; the other three would be three more single-purpose external links attached to the same grouping concept (sdk:dataflow-tool-integrations) with no additional distinguishing fact. The page itself explicitly disclaims completeness here ('There are too many third party integrations to evaluate and list... absence of a mention in these pages is no judgement on importance or quality'), which further supports treating this list as illustrative chrome rather than a set of individually load-bearing facts.

cross_component_finding: Both quarkus:extension and sdk:spring-data-couchbase-compatibility appear on this page purely as forward-references back to compatibility.json's own material ('Quarkus integration is covered in the Couchbase Quarkus Java Extension docs', 'many examples of using the SDK with Spring Boot and Spring Data') - this page adds no new version-gated facts for either, only restating that the integration exists and pointing elsewhere. No duplicate relations were added for them beyond the concept reuse itself, to avoid manufacturing near-identical relations from two pages that are, on this specific point, saying the same thing with less detail on this page.
cross_product_finding: spark:connector's link is the only genuinely unambiguous cross-product link in this entire batch: every other cross-product link in the batch (server/current/, quarkus-extension/current/, operator/current/) uses the version-agnostic 'current' alias, which this project's server/ extractions have already shown can correspond to different concrete version folders (server/8.0/...) depending on when the source was captured - exactly the ambiguity that led this batch to mint placeholder concepts (server:scopes-and-collections, server:self-managed-deployment) rather than guess a page_id. spark-connector/3.5/java-api.md pins an explicit version instead, so it was safe to record directly as a page_id-shaped seeAlso object without a placeholder.
